summary.native: the foundation of something; how often or under what conditions something is done; the reason for a decision

etymology.ko: 그리스어 basis('걸음; 발을 딛고 서는 자리, 받침')가 라틴어 basis(토대)를 거쳐 1570년대 영어에 들어왔다. 그리스어 basis는 bainein(가다, 걷다, 발을 딛다)에서 나왔다. 처음에는 건물 같은 물체의 '밑바닥, 토대'를 뜻했고, 생각·제도처럼 눈에 보이지 않는 것의 '기초, 근거'로 쓰인 것은 1600년 무렵부터다. base(밑바닥, 기지)도 같은 라틴어 basis에서 프랑스어를 거쳐 온 말이다.
etymology.native: From Latin basis, 'foundation', from Greek basis, 'a step; that on which one stands, a base', from bainein, 'to go, walk, step'. It entered English in the 1570s meaning the bottom or foundation of a physical thing; figurative senses for ideas and systems date from around 1600. Base comes from the same Latin word through French.

grammar.ko: 셀 수 있는 명사로 복수형은 bases(/ˈbeɪsiːz/)다. base의 복수형 bases(/ˈbeɪsɪz/)와 철자가 같아 발음으로만 구별된다.
grammar.native: Basis is countable; its plural is bases, pronounced /ˈbeɪsiːz/. The plural of base is spelled the same way but pronounced /ˈbeɪsɪz/.

grammar.ko: '~을 근거로'는 on the basis of + 명사, '~라는 이유로'는 on the basis that + 절이다. 전치사는 on을 쓴다.
grammar.native: Use on the basis of + noun, or on the basis that + clause. The preposition is on.

grammar.ko: '얼마나 자주, 어떤 조건으로'는 on a + 형용사 + basis 꼴이다: on a daily basis(매일), on a part-time basis(시간제로). 부정관사 a를 빠뜨리지 않는다.
grammar.native: The pattern on a + adjective + basis describes how often or under what conditions: on a daily basis, on a part-time basis. Do not leave out a.

grammar.ko: '~의 기초'는 the basis of/for + 명사다. form/provide the basis for(~의 기초가 되다)가 자주 짝을 이룬다.
grammar.native: For foundations, use the basis of or for + noun. Form or provide the basis for is a common combination.

meaning.native: the important facts, ideas, or principles that something is built on and can develop from

usage.ko: 계획·이론·관계 등이 딛고 선 핵심 생각이나 사실을 말한다. form/provide the basis for, the basis of + 명사 꼴이 흔하다.
usage.native: Refers to the main idea or fact that a plan, theory, or relationship rests on. Common in form or provide the basis for, and the basis of + noun.

examples.text: Trust is the basis of any good working relationship.
Your notes from the meeting will form the basis of the final report.
examples.ko: 회의에서 적어 두신 내용이 최종 보고서의 토대가 될 겁니다.

examples.text: These figures give us a solid basis for next year's budget.
examples.ko: 이 수치들은 내년 예산을 짜는 데 든든한 기초가 된다.

meaning.ko: (on a ~ basis 꼴로) 주기, 빈도: ~마다, ~ 단위로
meaning.native: used in on a daily, weekly, or regular basis to say how often something happens

usage.ko: on a daily/weekly/monthly/regular basis 꼴로 어떤 일이 얼마나 자주 일어나는지 말한다. 업무 문서나 격식 있는 말에서 특히 많이 쓴다.
usage.native: Used in on a daily, weekly, monthly, or regular basis to say how often something happens. It is especially common in work writing and formal speech.

examples.text: We back up all our files on a daily basis.
The team meets on a weekly basis to review progress.
examples.ko: 팀은 매주 모여 진행 상황을 점검한다.

examples.text: You should change your password on a regular basis.

meaning.ko: (on a ~ basis 꼴로) 방식, 조건: ~로, ~ 조건으로
meaning.native: used in on a part-time, voluntary, or similar basis to say in what way or under what conditions something is done

usage.ko: on a part-time/temporary/voluntary/first-come, first-served basis처럼 일이 어떤 조건이나 방식으로 이루어지는지 말한다. 채용·예약·공지에 자주 나온다.
usage.native: Used in phrases such as on a part-time, temporary, voluntary, or first-come, first-served basis to describe the arrangement. It often appears in job ads, bookings, and notices.

examples.text: She works for us on a part-time basis.
Seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
We'll use the new system on a trial basis for three months.
examples.ko: 새 시스템을 석 달 동안 시범적으로 써 보겠습니다.

examples.text: Requests for extra leave are decided on a case-by-case basis.
examples.ko: 추가 휴가 신청은 사안별로 따로 결정한다.

meaning.native: the reason or facts that support a decision, action, or claim

usage.ko: 결정·주장·행동이 무엇을 바탕으로 이루어졌는지 말한다. on the basis of + 명사(~을 근거로), have no basis(근거가 없다)가 흔하다.
usage.native: Used for the facts or reasons behind a decision, action, or claim. Common in on the basis of + noun, and have no basis.

examples.text: Candidates are chosen on the basis of their experience, not their age.
examples.ko: 지원자는 나이가 아니라 경력을 근거로 뽑힌다.

examples.text: On what basis did you decide to cancel the order?
The rumor about layoffs has no basis in fact.
examples.ko: 정리 해고에 관한 소문은 사실 근거가 전혀 없다.

cautions.ko: base와 basis를 헷갈리기 쉽다. base는 물건의 밑바닥이나 기지·본거지(the base of a lamp, a military base), basis는 생각·결정의 기초나 근거(the basis of the plan)다.
cautions.native: Base is the physical bottom of something or a place, such as the base of a lamp or a military base. Basis is the idea or fact that something is built on: the basis of the plan.

cautions.ko: '~을 바탕으로'는 on the basis of 또는 based on이다. '~에'에 끌려 in the basis of라고 하지 않는다. based in은 '~에 본사를 둔'이라는 전혀 다른 뜻이다(a company based in Seoul).
cautions.native: Say on the basis of or based on, not in the basis of. Note that based in means 'having its main office in': a company based in Seoul.

cautions.ko: on a daily basis는 사실상 every day와 같은 뜻이다. 문서에서는 흔하지만 일상 대화에서는 every day가 짧고 자연스럽다.
cautions.native: On a daily basis usually just means every day. It is common in writing, but in everyday speech every day or daily is simpler and more natural.

cautions.ko: '기본급'을 basis salary라고 하지 않는다. 명사 앞에서 '기본'을 뜻할 때는 base salary나 basic salary처럼 base, basic을 쓴다.
cautions.native: Do not use basis before a noun to mean 'basic'. Say base salary or basic salary, not basis salary.

note.ko: 얼마나 자주, 또는 어떤 조건으로 하는지를 밝히는 틀. daily, regular, part-time, trial 같은 말이 들어간다.
note.native: States how often or on what terms something is done; daily, regular, part-time, and trial are the usual fillers.

patterns.example: Contractors are paid on a monthly basis, not per project.
patterns.example_ko: 협력업체 직원은 건당이 아니라 월 단위로 돈을 받는다.

note.ko: 무엇을 근거로 결정했는지 밝히는 격식체. in the basis of 라고 하지 않는다. 짧게는 based on 을 쓴다.
note.native: A formal way to name the grounds for a decision. Never in the basis of; the shorter based on does the same job.

patterns.example: The claim was rejected on the basis of the medical records.
patterns.example_ko: 그 청구는 진료 기록을 근거로 기각되었다.

note.ko: 뒷일의 바탕이 된다는 뜻. 연구 결과나 합의를 소개할 때 provide the basis for 와 함께 쓴다.
note.native: Says something is what a later step is built on; provide the basis for works the same way when introducing findings or an accord.

patterns.example: The 2019 survey formed the basis for this year's targets.

note.ko: 주장에 사실 근거가 없다고 반박하는 굳은 표현. 해명 자료에서 소문을 부인할 때 쓴다.
note.native: A set phrase for denying a claim as unfounded; companies use it in statements that reject a rumour.

patterns.example: The company said the rumour had no basis in fact.
patterns.example_ko: 회사는 그 소문이 사실에 근거가 없다고 밝혔다.

difference.ko: base는 밑바닥이나 본거지이고, 명사 앞에서 기본을 뜻할 때도 base를 쓴다(base salary). 생각이나 결정의 바탕은 basis다.
difference.native: Base is the bottom of a thing or a headquarters, and it is the form used before nouns, as in base salary. The grounds of a decision is a basis.

confusables.example: Her base salary is fixed, and bonuses are paid on the basis of sales.

difference.ko: basics는 먼저 익혀야 할 기초 내용들을 뜻해 늘 복수로 쓰고, basis는 하나의 바탕이나 근거를 뜻한다.
difference.native: Basics is always plural and means the first things to learn; a basis is one foundation or one set of grounds.

confusables.example: Learn the basics of the software first; they are the basis of everything else.

difference.ko: grounds는 해고나 소송의 공식 사유를 뜻해 복수로 쓰고, on grounds of 꼴이 흔하다. basis는 더 넓은 바탕까지 아우른다.
difference.native: Grounds is plural and names the formal reason for a dismissal or a lawsuit, usually in on grounds of. Basis covers wider foundations too.

confusables.example: She was dismissed on grounds of misconduct, with no basis for appeal.
